identificationModule.briefTitle: NALIRI-XELOX+AK104 for First-line Treatment of Advanced PDAC
identificationModule.officialTitle: Nanoliposomal Irinotecan and XELOX (NALIRI-XELOX) in Combination With Cadonilimab for First-Line Treatment of Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma : A Single-arm, Phase II Study

leadSponsor.name: Cancer Institute and Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is a single-center, Phase II Study to assess the efficacy and safety of the regimen of Nanoliposomal Irinotecan and XELOX (NALIRI-XELOX) in combination with Cadonilimab in subjects with advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma who have not previously received systemic treatment.

armGroups.label: NALIRI-XELOX+AK104

interventions.name: Nanoliposomal Irinotecan+Oxaliplatin +Capecitabine+Cadonilimab
interventions.description: Use the above medications on a regular basis

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events [Safety and Tolerability] Adverse Events (AEs) Incidence, Serious Adverse Events (SAE) Incidence

locations.facility: Cancer Institute and Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences
